name: Lost Memories
source:
You’ve always dreamed of escaping your unhappy life, but you didn’t think it was possible. After getting caught in a traffic accident, however, you regain consciousness in an unfamiliar world.

It’s a world of magic and monsters, where a once-peaceful kingdom now suffers under the oppressive reign of a man who calls himself the Dark Lord.

When this world’s people see you, they rejoice, for you match the description of the prophesied hero who will save them.

Fortunately, you aren’t alone. Three young women from your world have also woken up in this strange place. Together, you set out on a journey to stop the Dark Lord and find a way back home.

But to do so, you’ll need to face your greatest fears…

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.isekai]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你一直梦想着逃离不幸的生活，但你认为这是不可能的。然而遭遇车祸后，你在一个陌生的世界中恢复了知觉。

这是一个充满魔法和怪物的世界，曾经和平的王国现在在一个自称黑魔王的人的压迫统治下遭受苦难。

当这个世界的人们看到你时，他们会很高兴，因为你符合预言中拯救他们的英雄的描述。

幸运的是，你并不孤单。你们世界的三位年轻女子也在这个陌生的地方醒来。你们一起踏上了阻止黑魔王并找到回家之路的旅程。

但要做到这一点，你需要面对你最大的恐惧……
